articles.summary: Origin Bank has announced the hiring of Scott Haygood as Commercial Relationship Manager, Regional Executive Vice President, and Merritt Grimm as Commercial Relationship Banker, Senior Vice President, serving the East Texas region.
articles.title: Origin Bank Adds Scott Haygood and Merritt Grimm | Origin Bank

articles.summary: Origin Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE: OBK) ("Origin"), the holding company for Origin Bank, announced today that it will transfer its stock exchange listing from the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) to the Texas Stock Exchange (“TXSE”). Origin expects to begin trading on the TXSE on October 13, 2026, and will continue to trade under its current ticker symbol “OBK”.
articles.title: Origin Bancorp, Inc. to Transfer Stock Exchange | Origin Bank

articles.summary: Origin Bank announced today the opening of its new Mobile Financial Center, marking an important step in the bank’s continued investment in the Mobile community. Located at 119 W. I-65 Service Road N., the newly constructed Financial Center replaces Origin’s former location at 3700 Dauphin St., Suite B, and provides convenient access to the responsive, relationship-focused experience Origin is known for.
articles.title: Origin Bank Opens Mobile Financial Center at | Origin Bank
